title: Fractal Origami
statementMd:
You have a square piece of paper with a side length equal to $1$ unit. In one operation, you fold each corner of the square to the center of the paper, thus forming another square with a side length equal to $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ units. By taking this square as a new square, you do the operation again and repeat this process a total of $N$ times.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/919a1710f9cc7639d6004df8ef62c130526441a0.png) Performing operations for $N = 2$.

After performing the set of operations, you open the paper with the same side up you started with and see some crease lines on it. Every crease line is one of two types: a mountain or a valley. A mountain is when the paper folds outward, and a valley is when the paper folds inward.

You calculate the sum of the length of all mountain crease lines on the paper and call it $M$. Similarly, you calculate for valley crease lines and call it $V$. You want to find the value of $\dfrac{M}{V}$.

It can be proved that this value can be represented in the form of $A + B\sqrt{2}$, where $A$ and $B$ are rational numbers. Let this $B$ be represented as an irreducible fraction $\dfrac{p}{q}$, your task is to print $p*inv(q)$ modulo $999\,999\,893$ **(note the unusual modulo)**, where $inv(q)$ is the [modular inverse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Modular_multiplicative_inverse) of $q$.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \leq t \leq 10^4$). Description of the test cases follows.

The only line of each test case contains an integer $N$ ($1 \leq N \leq 10^9$), the number of operations you perform on the square paper.

## Output

For each test case, print on a new line the required answer.

## Note

The blue lines in the given figures represent mountain crease lines, and the green lines represent valley crease lines.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5466a048c19c19b5775c4d56d4ebe9e8380b2422.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/189dbabaa284bddc88c440bbfd74126f562ea929.png)Crease lines after $1$ operation $(\dfrac{M}{V} = 0)$.Crease lines after $2$ operations $(\dfrac{M}{V} = \sqrt{2} - 1)$.
statementZhMd:
你有一张边长为 $1$ 个单位的正方形纸片。进行一次操作时，将正方形的每个角折到纸张的中心，从而形成一个边长为 $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ 个单位的正方形。将这个正方形作为新的正方形，再次进行该操作，并重复此过程，总共进行 $N$ 次。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/919a1710f9cc7639d6004df8ef62c130526441a0.png) 进行 $N = 2$ 次操作。

完成所有操作后，你将纸张以开始时朝上的那一面展开，并在纸上看到一些折痕。每条折痕都属于以下两种类型之一：山折或谷折。山折是指纸张向外折叠，谷折是指纸张向内折叠。

计算纸张上所有山折折痕的长度之和，记为 $M$。类似地，计算谷折折痕的长度之和，记为 $V$。你的任务是求出 $\dfrac{M}{V}$ 的值。

可以证明，这个值可以表示为 $A + B\sqrt{2}$，其中 $A$ 和 $B$ 是有理数。将 $B$ 表示为最简分数 $\dfrac{p}{q}$，你的任务是输出 $p*inv(q)$ 对 $999\,999\,893$ 取模后的结果 **（请注意这个不寻常的模数）**，其中 $inv(q)$ 是 $q$ 的[模逆元](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Modular_multiplicative_inverse)。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例仅包含一行，其中有一个整数 $N$（$1 \le N \le 10^9$），表示你对正方形纸片进行的操作次数。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，在新的一行中输出所求答案。

## 说明

给出图中的蓝线表示山折折痕，绿线表示谷折折痕。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5466a048c19c19b5775c4d56d4ebe9e8380b2422.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/189dbabaa284bddc88c440bbfd74126f562ea929.png)进行 $1$ 次操作后的折痕（$\dfrac{M}{V} = 0$）。进行 $2$ 次操作后的折痕（$\dfrac{M}{V} = \sqrt{2} - 1$）。
